### Tenses
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Summary|Tenses Summary]] — Scenario-based master guide showing when and why to use each English tense in daily/professional life.
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Present Tense/Simple Present Tense|Simple Present Tense]] — Facts, habits, routines, and scheduled events.
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Present Tense/Present Continuous Tense|Present Continuous Tense]] — Actions happening now, temporary situations, and future arrangements.
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Present Tense/Present Perfect Tense|Present Perfect Tense]] — Completed actions with present relevance and life experiences.
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Present Tense/Present Perfect Continuous|Present Perfect Continuous Tense]] — Actions that started in the past and are still continuing, with emphasis on duration.
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Past Tense/Simple Past Tense|Simple Past Tense]] — Completed actions at a specific time in the past.
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Past Tense/Past Continuous Tense|Past Continuous Tense]] — Actions in progress at a specific past time, parallel or interrupted actions.
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Past Tense/Past Perfect Tense|Past Perfect Tense]] — Which of two past actions happened first; cause-effect in the past.
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Past Tense/Past Perfect Continuous Tense|Past Perfect Continuous Tense]] — Duration of an action before another past event.
- [[English Communication/Tenses/Future Tense/Simple Future Tense|Simple Future Tense]] — Future actions, predictions, promises, and spontaneous decisions.
